ModMetaData.name: Dryads Example Pack: Resinmaker and Rescuer
ModMetaData.author: GuanYu Lu
ModMetaData.description: Example pack: two new Gauranlen dryad castes filling niches no vanilla or VIE dryad covers. The resinmaker dryad periodically produces chemfuel; the rescuer dryad can be trained to rescue downed allies from the battlefield. Pure XML, no Harmony, no framework dependencies. Demonstrates the minimal def set (ThingDef race + PawnKindDef + GauranlenTreeModeDef) needed to add a dryad caste to the Gauranlen tree mode menu.
